item.title: Self-Hosted DNS-over-QUIC Servers: Stubby vs dnsproxy vs getdns (2026)
item.description: DNS-over-QUIC (DoQ, RFC 9250) is the newest protocol for encrypted DNS resolution, combining the security of TLS 1.3 with QUIC’s zero-RTT connection establishment and improved performance over TCP-based DoT. While DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-HTTPS are widely deployed, DoQ represents the next generation of encrypted DNS with lower latency and better connection resilience.
